name: Azumami Kureha
source: One of the "Punishers" in the international organization aiming for the annihilation of Chikan "Innocence". Alias: Itazura Kuchizashi Hime (The princess who impales others for pranks). The outward appearance is adorable, but Kureha is really male. He understands he exudes feminine appeal and uses this appeal to hunt Chikan. Chikan fooled by his appearance who approach Kureha as a target are instead driven to orgasm by Kureha's superb fingering techniques.
